name: freetunes
description: Music on Freenet: build, test and publish scripts for the contracts and the site

scripts.build:contract: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p freetunes-chunk -p freetunes-release -p freetunes-directory -p freetunes-identity -p freetunes-comments -p freetunes-reports && node -e "for (const n of ['chunk','release','directory','identity','comments','reports']) require('fs').copyFileSync('target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/freetunes_' + n + '.wasm', 'ui/src/' + n + '.wasm')"
scripts.build: npm run build:contract && npm run build:ui
scripts.freenet:publish: npm run freenet:build && fdev website publish ui/dist --key freetunes
scripts.freenet:update: npm run freenet:build && fdev website update ui/dist --key freetunes
scripts.test: npm run test:ui && npm run test:contract
